mustEstablish.requirement: Constraint turns possibility into realizable paths
Structure preserves relations through configuration and compression
Regions and networks give local differences range
Navigation requires position reference and viable paths

canonicalMeaning.canonicalQuestion: How Reality Moves from Difference to Navigable Structure
canonicalMeaning.canonicalTitle: How Reality Moves from Difference to Navigable Structure
canonicalMeaning.centralThesis: Reality formation does not have to begin with complete objects. It can begin with distinguishable Difference. Constraint selects realizable paths, Structure preserves relations, regions and networks extend them, and stable references finally make position, direction, and navigation readable.

memberCanonicalMeanings.canonicalThesis: 差异是现实形成能够开始的最低结构条件：只有状态之间出现可区分的不等价，关系、比较、边界与方向才获得形成条件；差异打开结构可能性，但不等于结构已经稳定。
约束不是单纯阻止变化，而是在多个可能路径中改变哪些关系能够发生、重复与维持；通过裁剪可实现空间，约束让部分差异得以保存并逐步形成稳定结构。
结构不仅是元素之间的连接，还会通过配置、压缩与连续性保存关系模式，使系统即使部分成分变化，仍能够维持可辨认的组织。
当结构关系形成持续差异，现实会出现不同区域、边界与连接网络；这些结构差异进一步决定信息、资源与影响能够如何传播。
导航精度来自可读取的结构：位置、方向与可行路径必须依赖稳定参考关系与坐标，而不是只知道一个目标就足够。
